rawRecord.short_description: Secure filesystem operations with sandboxed directory access, atomic writes, and path traversal protection.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides secure access to local filesystems with strict directory sandboxing, symlink attack prevention, and atomic write operations. Includes 17 tools for reading, writing, editing, copying, and searching files with support for line-range reads, concurrent multi-file operations, and streaming for large files. Features operation-specific symlink policies, null byte rejection, and Docker-first deployment for container isolation.
